articleTitle: Microsoft Expands Copilot’s Reach into Windows and Local Files

sources.title: Introducing Copilot Actions, new agents, and tools to empower IT teams - Microsoft
Microsoft is giving Copilot more control over Windows and your files
Microsoft gives Copilot access to your local files and control of Windows - Crypto Briefing
Microsoft's Hybrid Intelligence gives Copilot more control over your files

claims.claim: At the recent Windows and Surface event, Microsoft announced a new Copilot feature that lets the AI system read local files on a user’s PC and take actions across the operating system.
claims.bestSource: Microsoft gives Copilot access to your local files and control of Windows - Crypto Briefing
claims.evidence:
Microsoft wants its AI assistant to stop just talking about your computer and start operating it. 
 At its Windows and Surface event on October 7, 2026, the company showed off a Copilot upgrade that will let the assistant reach into local files on your PC and carry out actions across the operating system. 
 

 The upgrade falls under a concept Microsoft is calling “Hybrid Intelligence.” Under this approach, apps and tools draw on a blend of AI models: some running on the device itself, others running in the cloud, with the goal of finishing tasks efficiently. 
 Taxes, accountants, and an AI that reads your inbox 
 Jacob Andreou, Microsoft’s EVP of Copilot, handled the on-stage pitch. At today’s Windows and Surface event, Microsoft showed off an upgrade to its Copilot AI system that will give it access to local files on your PC and the ability to take actions across the OS.

claims.claim: Early adopters such as Dow, Bank of Queensland Group, and Eaton report significant operational gains from Copilot.
claims.bestSource: Introducing Copilot Actions, new agents, and tools to empower IT teams - Microsoft
